unit_cn: Unit 4 Customs and Traditions 习俗与传统
source: 上外版(SFLEP)必修第一册 Unit 4 Glossary 真词(跳过 △ 超纲词与专有名词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、习俗/成人礼/校友返校主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Every culture has its own custom for welcoming a new year.
words.example_cn: 每种文化都有迎接新年的习俗。

words.example_en: Giving children red packets is a tradition during Spring Festival.
words.example_cn: 给孩子发红包是春节期间的一个传统。

words.example_en: A special ceremony is held to mark a young person's coming of age.
words.example_cn: 人们举行一个特别的典礼来标志年轻人的成年。

words.meaning_cn: 个人;个体;个人的;单独的
words.example_en: Today the festival is more of an individual celebration than a family one.
words.example_cn: 如今这个节日更像是个人的庆祝,而非家庭的庆祝。

words.example_en: Respected elders are invited to perform the ceremony for the boys.
words.example_cn: 人们邀请受人尊敬的长辈为男孩们主持这个仪式。

words.example_en: The three threads represent three promises the boy makes.
words.example_cn: 这三根线象征着男孩许下的三个承诺。

words.example_en: Coming-of-age traditions vary from culture to culture.
words.example_cn: 成人仪式因文化不同而有所差异。

words.example_en: These customs vary significantly from one region to another.
words.example_cn: 这些习俗在不同地区之间差异显著。

words.example_en: Nearly every society has specific rituals to mark adulthood.
words.example_cn: 几乎每个社会都有特定的仪式来标志成年。

words.example_en: The ceremony is meant to symbolise the change from childhood to adulthood.
words.example_cn: 这个仪式旨在象征从童年到成年的转变。

words.example_en: Homecoming refers to a tradition at many American schools.
words.example_cn: 校友返校指的是许多美国学校的一种传统。

words.example_en: After you have graduated, you can go back to visit your old campus.
words.example_cn: 毕业之后,你可以回去看看你的老校园。

words.example_en: The whole celebration begins on campus with the current students.
words.example_cn: 整个庆祝活动从校园里在校生开始。

words.example_en: The festival starts with the current students at the school.
words.example_cn: 这个庆典从学校里现在的在校生开始。

words.example_en: Some students rent traditional clothes just for the ceremony.
words.example_cn: 有些学生专门为这个仪式租借传统服装。

words.meaning_cn: 高年级学生;年长者;高级的
words.example_en: A senior is an older student in the higher grades of a school.
words.example_cn: 高年级学生是指学校里年级较高的学生。

words.example_en: The school holds an election to choose the Homecoming King and Queen.
words.example_cn: 学校举行选举来选出返校节的国王和王后。

words.example_en: A court of princes and princesses will accompany the king and queen.
words.example_cn: 一群王子和公主会陪伴着国王和王后。

words.meaning_cn: (返校节的)随从队伍;王宫;法庭
words.example_en: The Homecoming Court is made up of first-year students.
words.example_cn: 返校节随从队伍由一年级学生组成。

words.example_en: The king and queen are selected from among the upper-level students.
words.example_cn: 国王和王后是从高年级学生中选拔出来的。

words.example_en: The students elected to the court are usually very active at school.
words.example_cn: 被选入随从队伍的学生通常在学校里非常活跃。

words.example_en: These students are deeply involved in many school activities.
words.example_cn: 这些学生深度参与许多学校活动。

words.example_en: Some towns stage a colourful parade for the whole community.
words.example_cn: 有些城镇为整个社区举办一场多彩的游行。

words.example_en: The school band will march through the streets during the parade.
words.example_cn: 学校乐队将在游行中穿过街道行进。

words.example_en: There is always a band playing music at the homecoming dance.
words.example_cn: 返校节舞会上总有一支乐队在演奏音乐。

words.example_en: The parade includes the marching band, sports teams and classic cars.
words.example_cn: 游行队伍包括鼓号队、运动队和古典老爷车。

words.example_en: It is a time for the whole town to gather and socialise.
words.example_cn: 这是整个城镇聚在一起交际的时刻。

words.example_en: Some schools keep the dance casual, while others make it a formal affair.
words.example_cn: 有些学校把舞会办得随意,而另一些则办得很正式。

words.example_en: For some schools the dance is quite a grand affair.
words.example_cn: 对一些学校来说,这场舞会是相当隆重的活动。

words.example_en: The dance is a time for the entire school to come together.
words.example_cn: 这场舞会是整个学校齐聚一堂的时刻。

words.example_en: A ceremony was held to mark the special occasion.
words.example_cn: 人们举行了一个仪式来纪念这个特别的场合。

words.example_en: Becoming an adult means taking on a greater sense of duty.
words.example_cn: 成年意味着承担起更大的责任感。

words.example_en: In the past, girls learned household skills to prepare for marriage.
words.example_cn: 过去,女孩们学习家务技能来为婚姻做准备。

words.example_en: The German ceremony is a kind of youth celebration for fourteen-year-olds.
words.example_cn: 这个德国仪式是为十四岁的人举办的一种青年庆典。

words.example_en: The ceremony marks a young person's entry into adulthood.
words.example_cn: 这个仪式标志着一个年轻人进入成年。

words.example_en: The three promises are to respect knowledge, parents and society.
words.example_cn: 这三个承诺是尊重知识、父母和社会。

words.example_en: Nearly every society has its own way to celebrate growing up.
words.example_cn: 几乎每个社会都有自己庆祝成长的方式。

words.example_en: People hold ceremonies to celebrate this important stage of life.
words.example_cn: 人们举行仪式来庆祝人生这一重要阶段。

words.example_en: The Jugendfeier in Germany is a serious celebration for young people.
words.example_cn: 德国的青年礼是为年轻人举办的一种庄重的庆祝活动。

words.example_en: Girls were taught cooking and sewing to prepare for the special day.
words.example_cn: 女孩们被教授烹饪和缝纫,为这个特别的日子做准备。

words.example_en: As adults, young people must shoulder more responsibilities.
words.example_cn: 作为成年人,年轻人必须承担更多责任。

words.example_en: In India, the boy promises to respect knowledge and his teacher.
words.example_cn: 在印度,男孩承诺尊重知识和他的老师。

words.example_en: Girls were taught cooking, sewing and other household skills.
words.example_cn: 女孩们被教授烹饪、缝纫和其他家务技能。

words.example_en: In ancient China, a hair-pinning ceremony was held for girls at fifteen.
words.example_cn: 在古代中国,人们为十五岁的女孩举行笄礼。

words.example_en: In modern times, the ceremony has become a personal celebration.
words.example_cn: 在现代,这个仪式已变成一种个人化的庆祝。

words.example_en: Friends and family gather together to celebrate the young adult.
words.example_cn: 亲朋好友聚在一起为这位年轻人庆祝。
